snippet.title: DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime! In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the DRAGON QUEST series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle.

Available December 3, 2026 on Nintendo Switch™ 2, Nintendo Switch™, PlayStation®5, XBOX Series X|S, XBOX on PC and Steam®.

Preorder now and get an early purchase bonus: the Adventure Starter Set!
Included Items:
[Contents]
- 10x Monster Munchies
- 3x Bonus Balls
- 5x Seeds of Skill

This bonus is included only for customers who purchase the main game or the Deluxe Edition by January 4th, 2027 at 23:59.
